name: Oni-ni-kanabo (Lit. “Oni With Iron Club”)
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 6, ranger 4

Casting Time immediate action
Components V

EFFECT

Range personal
Duration one attack
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

This spell can only be cast as an immediate reaction to being targeted by an action (attack, spell, etc) that could result in the caster of this spell taking hit point damage. The caster reduces all damage from that attack by half. This only applies to the attack that this spell was made as an immediate reaction to.

Translation Note: The term oni-ni-kanabo means someone or something that is unable to be defeated. It is often used to describe something invincible.
